slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title (shown inline, quiet)

slots.name: right
slots.about: how many answers were right in the run just finished

slots.name: total
slots.about: how many were asked; 0 shows the empty note

slots.name: bands
slots.about: result bands: id, min (share right from 0 to 1, the first band's min is 0), word (the big result), verdict (one line), why (a short paragraph)

slots.name: missed
slots.about: the questions missed: id (1 up), ask, answer; 0 or more

slots.name: score_line
slots.about: the line under the verdict; may read right, total and share (0 to 1, capped)

slots.name: best_tag
slots.about: the small tag shown when this run beats every earlier kept run

slots.name: missed_label
slots.about: the toggle that shows the missed questions; may read miss_count and open

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: shown in place of the result when total is 0

slots.name: kept_line
slots.about: the footer line once kept; may read best, total and tries

slots.name: toggle
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: opens or closes the missed questions

slots.name: finish
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps this run (best and tries) once; the host then leaves the lesson

empty.shows: empty_note in place of the result and the missed list; finish keeps nothing

attention.shows: best_chip under the word: this run beats every earlier kept run (never on the first)

fallback.shows: no missed toggle; a clean run is the word, verdict, score and paragraph only

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, delays, swap and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the new best is a star plus words, the missed toggle turns its chevron, each missed answer carries a check icon
